en: Micah 1

p.src: 1  The LORD’s word that came to Micah of Morasheth in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.

ja: モレシェテ人ミカに臨んだ主 の言葉。これは、ユダの
ヨタム、アハズ、ヒゼキヤの
に、サマリアとエルサレムについて彼が
en: The LORD’s word that came to Micah of Morasheth in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.
u.src: 1  The LORD’s word that came to Micah of Morasheth in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.

ja: 1:1 すべて大文字の「主」または「神」はヘブル語のיהוה（ヤハウェ）から来ている。ただし、短い形のיה（ヤハ）から来ていると記されている場合を除く。
en: 1:1 When rendered in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, “LORD” or “GOD” is the translation of God’s Proper Name (Hebrew “יהוה”, usually pronounced Yahweh).

zh: 為撒馬利亞和耶路撒冷唱哀歌

p.src: 2  Hear, you peoples, all of you! Listen, O earth, and all that is therein. Let the Lord GOD be witness against you, the Lord from his holy temple.

en: Hear, you peoples, all of you! Listen, O earth, and all that is therein. Let the Lord GOD be witness against you, the Lord from his holy temple.
u.src: 2  Hear, you peoples, all of you! Listen, O earth, and all that is therein. Let the Lord GOD be witness against you, the Lord from his holy temple.

ja: 1:2 「主」と訳された言葉は「アドナイ」である。
en: 1:2 The word translated “Lord” is “Adonai.”

p.src: 3  For behold, the LORD comes out of his place, and will come down and tread on the high places of the earth.

en: For behold, the LORD comes out of his place, and will come down and tread on the high places of the earth.
u.src: 3  For behold, the LORD comes out of his place, and will come down and tread on the high places of the earth.

ja: 1:3 「見よ」はヘブル語の「הִנֵּה」（ヒネ）に由来し、「見なさい」「注意を向けなさい」などの意味をもつ間投詞である。
en: 1:3 “Behold”, from “הִנֵּה”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection.

p.src: 4  The mountains melt under him, and the valleys split apart like wax before the fire, like waters that are poured down a steep place.

ja: のろうのように溶け、 谷々は、
en: The mountains melt under him, and the valleys split apart like wax before the fire, like waters that are poured down a steep place.
u.src: 4  The mountains melt under him, and the valleys split apart like wax before the fire, like waters that are poured down a steep place.

p.src: 5  “All this is for the disobedience of Jacob, and for the sins of the house of Israel. What is the disobedience of Jacob? Isn’t it Samaria? And what are the high places of Judah? Aren’t they Jerusalem?

ja: きのため、 イスラエルの
のためである。 ヤコブの
か。 サマリアではないか。 ユダの
か。 エルサレムではないか。
en: “All this is for the disobedience of Jacob, and for the sins of the house of Israel. What is the disobedience of Jacob? Isn’t it Samaria? And what are the high places of Judah? Aren’t they Jerusalem?
u.src: 5  “All this is for the disobedience of Jacob, and for the sins of the house of Israel. What is the disobedience of Jacob? Isn’t it Samaria? And what are the high places of Judah? Aren’t they Jerusalem?

p.src: 6  Therefore I will make Samaria like a rubble heap of the field, like places for planting vineyards; and I will pour down its stones into the valley, and I will uncover its foundations.

ja: それゆえ、私はサマリアを
の山とし、 ぶどう畑を
en: Therefore I will make Samaria like a rubble heap of the field, like places for planting vineyards; and I will pour down its stones into the valley, and I will uncover its foundations.
u.src: 6  Therefore I will make Samaria like a rubble heap of the field, like places for planting vineyards; and I will pour down its stones into the valley, and I will uncover its foundations.

p.src: 7  All her idols will be beaten to pieces, all her temple gifts will be burned with fire, and I will destroy all her images; for of the hire of a prostitute has she gathered them, and to the hire of a prostitute shall they return.”

ja: かれ、 神殿に献げられた贈り物はすべて
かれ、 私はそのすべての
を破壊する。 それらは娼婦の
で集められたので、 娼婦の報酬に
en: All her idols will be beaten to pieces, all her temple gifts will be burned with fire, and I will destroy all her images; for of the hire of a prostitute has she gathered them, and to the hire of a prostitute shall they return.”
u.src: 7  All her idols will be beaten to pieces, all her temple gifts will be burned with fire, and I will destroy all her images; for of the hire of a prostitute has she gathered them, and to the hire of a prostitute shall they return.”

p.src: 8  For this I will lament and wail. I will go stripped and naked. I will howl like the jackals and mourn like the ostriches.

ja: く。 ジャッカルのように泣き叫び、 だちょうのように嘆く。
en: For this I will lament and wail. I will go stripped and naked. I will howl like the jackals and mourn like the ostriches.
u.src: 8  For this I will lament and wail. I will go stripped and naked. I will howl like the jackals and mourn like the ostriches.

p.src: 9  For her wounds are incurable; for it has come even to Judah. It reaches to the gate of my people, even to Jerusalem.

ja: は治らない。 それはユダにまで
にまで、 エルサレムにまで達した。
en: For her wounds are incurable; for it has come even to Judah. It reaches to the gate of my people, even to Jerusalem.
u.src: 9  For her wounds are incurable; for it has come even to Judah. It reaches to the gate of my people, even to Jerusalem.

p.src: 10  Don’t tell it in Gath. Don’t weep at all. At Beth Ophrah I have rolled myself in the dust.

ja: くな。 ベテ・レアフラ で、私はちりの
en: Don’t tell it in Gath. Don’t weep at all. At Beth Ophrah I have rolled myself in the dust.
u.src: 10  Don’t tell it in Gath. Don’t weep at all. At Beth Ophrah I have rolled myself in the dust.

ja: 1:10 ベテ・レアフラは文字どおりには「ちりの家」という意味である。
en: 1:10 Beth Ophrah means literally “House of Dust.”

p.src: 11  Pass on, inhabitant of Shaphir, in nakedness and shame. The inhabitant of Zaanan won’t come out. The wailing of Beth Ezel will take from you his protection.

ja: ぎよ。 ツァアナンに
ない。 ベテ・エツェルの
きは、あなたがたから支えを奪う。
en: Pass on, inhabitant of Shaphir, in nakedness and shame. The inhabitant of Zaanan won’t come out. The wailing of Beth Ezel will take from you his protection.
u.src: 11  Pass on, inhabitant of Shaphir, in nakedness and shame. The inhabitant of Zaanan won’t come out. The wailing of Beth Ezel will take from you his protection.

p.src: 12  For the inhabitant of Maroth waits anxiously for good, because evil has come down from the LORD to the gate of Jerusalem.

ja: ち焦がれて身もだえする。
en: For the inhabitant of Maroth waits anxiously for good, because evil has come down from the LORD to the gate of Jerusalem.
u.src: 12  For the inhabitant of Maroth waits anxiously for good, because evil has come down from the LORD to the gate of Jerusalem.

p.src: 13  Harness the chariot to the swift steed, inhabitant of Lachish. She was the beginning of sin to the daughter of Zion; for the transgressions of Israel were found in you.

ja: につなげ。 あなたはシオンの
まりであった。 イスラエルの
en: Harness the chariot to the swift steed, inhabitant of Lachish. She was the beginning of sin to the daughter of Zion; for the transgressions of Israel were found in you.
u.src: 13  Harness the chariot to the swift steed, inhabitant of Lachish. She was the beginning of sin to the daughter of Zion; for the transgressions of Israel were found in you.

p.src: 14  Therefore you will give a parting gift to Moresheth Gath. The houses of Achzib will be a deceitful thing to the kings of Israel.

をする。 アクジブの
en: Therefore you will give a parting gift to Moresheth Gath. The houses of Achzib will be a deceitful thing to the kings of Israel.
u.src: 14  Therefore you will give a parting gift to Moresheth Gath. The houses of Achzib will be a deceitful thing to the kings of Israel.

p.src: 15  I will yet bring a conqueror to you, inhabitants of Mareshah. The glory of Israel will come to Adullam.

ja: む者よ、 私は再び、あなたを征服する
en: I will yet bring a conqueror to you, inhabitants of Mareshah. The glory of Israel will come to Adullam.
u.src: 15  I will yet bring a conqueror to you, inhabitants of Mareshah. The glory of Israel will come to Adullam.

p.src: 16  Shave your heads, and cut off your hair for the children of your delight. Enlarge your baldness like the vulture, for they have gone into captivity from you!

ja: どもたちのために、 頭をそり、髪を切り落とせ。 はげわしのように、頭を広くそり上げよ。 子どもたちはあなたのもとから
として連れ去られたからだ。
en: Shave your heads, and cut off your hair for the children of your delight. Enlarge your baldness like the vulture, for they have gone into captivity from you!
u.src: 16  Shave your heads, and cut off your hair for the children of your delight. Enlarge your baldness like the vulture, for they have gone into captivity from you!
